content.short: Bamboo Relay provides a 0x relayer protocol for trading, lending, and borrowing ERC20 tokens from users' wallets.
content.description: Founded in 2017 by Joshua Richardson and operating from early 2018 as an Australian-based DeFi relayer, Bamboo Relay enables users to access DeFi activities directly from their wallets. No single protocol is required—once connected, users can trade, borrow, and lend without leaving their wallet interface. Bamboo Relay continues development toward broader trading options, including margin trading, to expand how users interact with DeFi.
content.meta: Bamboo Relay provides a 0x relayer for ERC20 trading, lending and borrowing from wallets. Discover Bamboo Relay and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
